newsitem.title: USA: ACE Cash says sells auto loan portfolio.
newsitem.headline: ACE Cash says sells auto loan portfolio.

text.p: ACE Cash Express Inc said it will sell its automobile loan portfolio for approximately $4 million.

ACE said Monday that it sold 60 percent of the portfolio and the company added that it has accepted a letter of intent from another party for the remaining portfolio which it expects to close within four to six weeks.

The automobile loan portfolio was a component of the Check Express acquisition. Since the company had intended to divest itself of this business segment, it will not recognize a gain or loss from the sale, it said.
The company said it intends to use the proceeds of the sale to expand the number of stores in existing markets, add new products and pursue franchise opportunities.
